title: Polish prosecutors say ‘too early’ to tell if Kraków gunman was motivated by political ideology
summary_full: Terrorism investigation will continue after suspect who killed six after opening fire in market square diedPolish prosecutors have said they do not currently have any evidence tying the man who killed six people and injured 16 in a rare mass shooting in Kraków to any particularly political ideology.The 24-year-old Polish national died in hospital early on Monday after being critically injured in a shootout with police officers as they apprehended him after the attack in the city’s busy market square on Saturday afternoon.
